songs.memory: Getting exposed to '80s British alternative around 1993 and pairing it with '90s rock and grunge. My college roommate loved British alternative.
songs.tags: Dorm Apartment / 80s Alternative / Friendship / First serious relationship / Great Roomates

songs.memory: Dorm life. The choices our friends make and how freshman-year life choices change the trajectory of life. Balancing home life and college life, and feeling broke.
songs.tags: Freshman year / Growing up / Grunge / Pivot from rap / Childhood friends moving on and meeting new college friends

songs.memory: Heavy metal was emerging, and heavy metal ballads were the rage. This one was the best. It was also timed to when I started middle school, had new friends, and started doing more things on my own, being dropped off places with friends. The bus scene at the end kind of gives me the feeling of moving on.
songs.tags: Middle School / Heavy Metal Ballads / Roller Skating / Starting over leaving the only place I had lived / Losing my bFFs that loved sports / DnD

songs.memory: I think having a hard rock band with keyboards in the music was extremely novel, and I just loved the sound. That and Sammy Hagar's voice with Eddie Van Halen was a game changer. I still love hearing it to this day. I likely first heard it on MTV.
songs.tags: Middle school / mullets / keyboards/synthesizers are cool

songs.memory: Greg got pulled onto the stage with Buffalo Tom. It was the last time we saw BT together before he moved to AZ to start his own life.
songs.tags: End of post college roomates / moving to the south / baseball / marraige  / concerts / greg on stage

songs.memory: Everclear played an Xmas Rave concert in Boston. Their portion of the show was half acoustic and half rock. It was one of the last shows with my college roommate.
songs.tags: Childhood memories / end of my grunge era / xmas rave / acoustic / concerts / ben folds five

songs.memory: It was tied back to a TV show, but life mirrored TV. My college roommates all moved to different states around the same time. This song always reminds me of the times together and the time we all moved on and started families.
songs.tags: 90210 / growing up / starting new life / friendships and distance

songs.memory: I always relate this song to holding my first son and working out while he slept. The song was upbeat, and the video was really cool. It feels like one of the last music video memories I have.
songs.tags: Birth of first child / commiting to fitness / inventions / innovation / technology

songs.memory: Close college friends' wedding song. It brings back memories of the actual wedding and how happy people were. It also tied back to my own relationship and makes me think about love and friendship.
songs.tags: Marriage / Friendship / Growing up / First alternative band that I fell in love with

songs.memory: Driving around southeastern Massachusetts on my way to see my girlfriend, now my wife. One of the best alternative songs with a female lead singer, which I discovered watching the early years of 90210.
songs.tags: WBRU / College / 90210 /Rhode Island / Taunton / First girlfriend

songs.memory: My then-girlfriend considered breaking up with me, and this song was playing as I was going to stay with a friend for the night. It was my first time going to his place after college, and I always tie those together.
songs.tags: breakup / adulthood / finding myself

songs.memory: An awkward teen time. I didn't have a girlfriend and was still trying to find myself. This song was a perfect love song and felt like what I yearned for.
songs.tags: rap / britisih / high school trying to find love
songs.album: The Great Adventures Of Slick Rick (Deluxe Edition)

songs.memory: Snoop Dogg gets introduced to our lives, tied to NWA, who, while not on this list, were a huge rap band for me growing up in high school. I just loved how Snoop changed how rappers approach lyrics, and the beat was amazing. Hardcore rap.
songs.tags: started college but still was attached to my hometown / not ready to grow up / taking different path than my childhood pals

songs.memory: PE had many great hits, but this was super high energy and one they owned, versus the other amazing one, Bring the Noise with Anthrax. They felt like a rock band in many regards. Amazing depth and deep lyrics. I listened to PE with my cousin, who introduced me to rap. This is one of the songs I remember playing on the way to an amusement park with my sister and her then-husband.
songs.tags: Amazing mix of lyrical rapper alongside a heavy beat.   Finding my sweetspot on the intersection of music

songs.memory: I was that guy who loved rap growing up in a very urban city. I ended up going to a private university, and grunge exploded in the first semester of freshman year, with an entirely different friend group. LP's music blended these two worlds unlike any other.
songs.tags: first band I felt got me,   Perfect blend of hip hop and rap.  Life changing events around relocating and marriage

songs.memory: The contrast of a goth-looking guy singing such a perfect love song. It was emotional and poetic, and the arrangement was elite. Again, a very modern sound at the time. The guitar sound was amazing. I came across this on MTV. The deeper introduction to their music came from my junior-year college roommate, who loved British alternative and also introduced me to the Smiths.
songs.tags: Emotional but also poetic / British Alternative

songs.memory: Wilmington is part vacation with Mike and Jess, but also where OTH was filmed. We did a set tour years later that made me love Wilmington even more, and it is one of the select cities in NC that I like to visit.
songs.tags: Late find (almost 15 years after the release) / Feelings about losing something / One Tree Hill / Vacation in Wilmington

songs.memory: Just the combination of prom and the end of high school. Heading to college in the fall. It was also interesting that the band was Boston-based.
songs.tags: High School Prom / End of high school / Moving on

songs.memory: Prospect St was where I lived until age 11. It taught me friendship and a love of sports. One of the kids from that time is still someone I chat with on occasion, and when we see each other, it is like time stood still.
songs.tags: 1986 Patriots / Football / Squish the fish / keyboards / prospect street

songs.memory: Toad was the center of our college years and the band we have seen consistently over the years. Friendships are still closely tied to this band, and the music has grown as we have grown, even today. The show at the Orpheum just seems to be the peak, when we were in college with no money and got to see them.
songs.tags: Consistency from my 20s until present. Band that always makes me happy / orpheum theater / college BFFs

songs.memory: The family watched Glee. We all had different music tastes and songs that we tied to that show. I have always loved songs that are melodic and memorable. This one feels like one of those songs.
songs.tags: Middle Age / Kids Starting to form their own opinions on music / calming song / glee

songs.memory: I was living in Boston. Boston is heavily Irish. It felt like U2 was adopted by the local Boston music scene. The song itself is extremely powerful, both the lyrics and the musical arrangement.
songs.tags: High School / Amnesty International / Alternative / Irish and Boston

songs.memory: My favorite song from the Singles album, which honored grunge. It was another movie by Cameron Crowe, like the movie featuring Tiny Dancer later on in the list. I loved how it tied back to an early grunge legend, Andrew Wood. The song was a perfect grunge song. Everyone had the Singles soundtrack and knew Alice in Chains from Man in the Box. This song just hit perfectly with the movie.
songs.tags: Grunge / Seattle / Singles / Cameron Crowe / sophomore year / flannel

songs.memory: The tour bus scene when this plays. It was really the beginning of the end of the story for the lead, who wanted to move home. I, in turn, felt I was home in NC when I saw this movie, but I really loved the song, the harmonies, and the characters.
songs.tags: Almost Famous / Billy Crudup / Friendship / Music

songs.memory: Ben Folds is from NC. The NC tie-in was that the song sort of predicted our move there. I'm not even sure we knew he was from there at the time, although his songs have ties to the area. Once we found out, it felt like a sign about being in the right place. Piano-based rock when alternative and grunge were taking off was a crazy thing to see in music. I loved his geek-like humor. Later on, I saw this even more with Weezer, and I loved their music.
songs.tags: Piano Rock Alternatve / Break ups / NC

songs.memory: Rap was a huge influence on me growing up. This song came out, and despite grunge taking over my playlist, it was amazing. It had hard-hitting beats and amazing vocals. It was part of the rotation with my friends who loved rap.
songs.tags: Busta Rhymes / Intellectual Rap Band / Amazing beats / college years / dorm life

songs.memory: We saw the Pumpkins at Lollapalooza. My roommate was a huge fan of the Pumpkins, especially this album. I love soft, quiet songs, and this was one of them.
songs.tags: lalapalooza / arrangement / college roomates

songs.song: There is a light that never goes out
songs.memory: My roommate junior year introduced me to the Smiths. I loved how they put their songs together and the confidence the singer had.
songs.tags: Confident british singer / intelligent and fun lyrics / college roomates

songs.memory: We went to a New Year's Eve concert at the Middle East. The music was intense. The basement had exposed pipes, and condensation was dripping off them. The music is super energetic and hardcore, but also very catchy.
songs.tags: New Years / Boston / Middle East / Ska / post college

songs.memory: This was the Beastie Boys going back to their punk roots after rap was their rise to fame. I loved the alternative-like music combined with rap. Sort of a precursor to what Linkin Park did later. It was a reintroduction to the band after a short hiatus and how they adapted to the industry's shift toward grunge. I found it myself, then saw them at the same Lollapalooza concert.
songs.tags: Rap / Rock / Alternative / growing up from rap to alternative with the band

songs.memory: Friends loved BNL. I went to a concert with those friends to see them with Guster. The Arlington reference is where my girlfriend, later my wife, lived with her friends. I lived nearby in Waltham.
songs.tags: Post college years / arlington / concert / guster
songs.album: Born on a Pirate Ship (Enhanced Edition)

songs.memory: I love the opening line about how the glove compartment is inaccurately named. Looking for simple paperwork and stumbling across souvenirs from a past life. I got introduced to Death Cab through The O.C. and loved their music immediately. Smooth lyrics and a great voice. This one was especially witty about the glovebox.
songs.tags: glove compartment / souvenirs / melodic / quiet indie rock

songs.memory: This song was everywhere in the 2010s. It was on the radio, at games, and in the car with the kids. Just a great melodic rock song.
songs.tags: 2010s alt-rock / anthem / family car rides / melodic

songs.memory: I really liked Halsey's sound when this came out. Catchy, synth-heavy pop that reminded me a bit of the '80s alternative I grew up on. I'm the huge Halsey fan, not the kids. I love all her music and the variety across rock, dance, and love songs.
songs.tags: everything is blue / modern synth-pop / melodic / 2010s

songs.memory: Big hooks and a fun, theatrical sound. It felt like a whole new wave of rock taking over in the mid-2000s, and the video was great. It felt emo-like, and I gravitated toward emo with this and Thnks fr th Mmrs.
songs.tags: las vegas / theatrical rock / catchy hooks / mid-2000s
songs.album: A Fever You Can't Sweat Out

songs.memory: Just a high-energy, catchy song from the late 2000s. Looking back now, the title feels like a funny nod to putting together a playlist of old memories. I gravitated toward emo with this and I Write Sins Not Tragedies. Fall Out Boy's connection to One Tree Hill gave it another association, since I loved that show.
songs.tags: mid-2000s pop-punk / catchy hooks / nostalgia / meta title

songs.memory: The opener to the Blue Album. I loved how it started with quiet acoustic picking before the heavy guitars kicked in. Great melodic rock right as I was finishing college.
songs.tags: blue album / acoustic to heavy / melodic / geek-rock / boston era

songs.memory: I liked All Time Low's earlier emo-pop stuff, and this one brought them into the 2020s with blackbear. It has that mix of rap and rock hooks I have always liked. I like All Time Low's music in general. I like collabs and love when rap-like music gets added in.
songs.tags: pop-punk / hip-hop crossover / modern closer / 2020s

songs.memory: Came out right around the end of high school. Great guitar riff over electronic beats, and the video of the guy in a crown carrying a deck chair around was classic MTV.
songs.tags: violator / british synth-pop / melodic guitar hook / mtv era

songs.memory: We saw them open for Barenaked Ladies in Boston in the mid-'90s. No drum kit, just acoustic guitars and hand percussion, plus that '4, 3, 2, 1' hook.
songs.tags: boston band / bnl opener / hand percussion / 4 3 2 1 hook

songs.memory: I really like the collabs Halsey and Travis Barker did together. Great hooks, heavy drums, and a modern take on the alt-rock and pop-punk sounds I grew up with. Finding YUNGBLUD was totally random, but I like his music in general. I like collabs and love when rap-like music gets added in.
songs.tags: travis barker / halsey / yungblud / emo-pop / modern crossover
